modules.name: Plugin Core
modules.responsibility: Guice-injected plugin lifecycle (startUp/shutDown), the 45s poll loop, reminder-milestone logic, and the user-facing config schema - the orchestrator that wires the API client's results into the panel's state.

key_files.purpose: Plugin entrypoint: startUp/shutDown, poll loop scheduling (scheduleWithFixedDelay), join-button handler, reminder milestone dedupe (remindersShown set), registers/unregisters six EventBus alerts listeners (loot - which also covers the mega-rare accomplishment allowlist, death, coffer, skill milestone, pet drop, one-time reward). pollEvents() also calls questMilestoneListener.checkQuests() directly each cycle - that listener has no EventBus subscription (see Alerts module).

RuneLite ConfigGroup interface declaring token, lootSharingEnabled, deathScreenshotsEnabled (both default off/opt-in), deathMessage (custom text, default blank), eventRemindersEnabled (default off/opt-in, gates the milestone reminders and signed-up-events summary), and accomplishmentSharingEnabled / petDropSharingEnabled (both default off/opt-in) settings.

modules.name: API Client
modules.responsibility: Wraps OkHttp calls to the catabot backend's plugin API (GET /events, POST /signup) behind an async callback interface, and classifies failures so callers can branch on cause (unauthorized vs. network vs. server).

key_files.purpose: fetchEvents() and signup() - builds requests, attaches Bearer auth header, parses JSON responses via Gson, routes errors through ApiCallback.

Four sendAlert() overloads to POST /alerts with the same Bearer auth pattern: with/without an image part, each with/without an optional title field (accomplishment/pet alerts pass one; loot/death/coffer don't and are unchanged) - all share one request-building/response-handling path. Has its own inline 401/unsuccessful/network handling rather than sharing EventsApiClient's (WRN-005).
Generic async result interface (onSuccess/onError) used by all API calls.
Enum classifying failures: UNAUTHORIZED (401), NETWORK (request never reached server), SERVER (unexpected status/malformed body).

modules.name: Alerts
modules.responsibility: Game-event listeners that detect loot/death/clan-coffer/accomplishment/pet moments client-side and hand off to AlertsApiClient for delivery to Discord via catabot. Most are @Subscribe on RuneLite's EventBus; QuestMilestoneListener is the one exception (see its key_files entry). Loot, death, pet drops, and 1750/2000/2200 total-level milestones capture a screenshot first; coffer, quest, other skill/XP milestones, and one-time-reward alerts post text only.

key_files.purpose: LOOT/DEATH/COFFER/ACCOMPLISHMENT/PET enum; wireValue() matches the bot's `kind` field.
Wraps DrawManager.requestNextFrameListener to capture the current client frame as PNG bytes via an async callback.

@Subscribe on NpcLootReceived, PlayerLootReceived, and RuneLite's own LootReceived (filtered to LootRecordType.EVENT/PICKPOCKET - catches chest/reward-interface content like Doom of Mokhaiotl that the first two never fire for; NPC/PLAYER-typed LootReceived is skipped to avoid duplicating the other two sources). Per item, independently runs two checks: non-stackable + worth >= 1.5m gp (ItemManager.getItemPrice) posts AlertKind.LOOT, gated on lootSharingEnabled (default off); item ID in a fixed 7-entry mega-rare allowlist (Twisted bow, Scythe of vitur, Tumeken's shadow, Ancient blood ornament kit, Mokhaiotl cloth, Eye of Ayak (uncharged), Avernic treads) regardless of value posts AlertKind.ACCOMPLISHMENT with a title, gated on accomplishmentSharingEnabled (default off) - an item can trigger both. Absorbed the former AccomplishmentLootListener.java (deleted) - see architecture.json key_decisions.
@Subscribe on ActorDeath, local player only; gated on config.deathScreenshotsEnabled() (default off); uses config.deathMessage() if set, else "Died."

@Subscribe on ChatMessage (ChatMessageType.CLAN_MESSAGE only - the system-broadcast type, not player-typed CLAN_CHAT); regex-matches coffer deposit/withdraw text; posts via AlertsApiClient's text-only sendAlert overload (no ScreenshotCapture dependency); always on, no config gate.

@Subscribe on StatChanged; tracks per-skill previous level/XP plus total level/XP (via Client.getTotalLevel()/getOverallExperience(), not a Skill.OVERALL StatChanged event) in-memory, never alerting on a skill's first observation this session (avoids false-firing on a veteran account's pre-existing 99s). Detects 99s, every 25m skill-XP milestone past 99, and every 50m total-XP milestone (all text-only). Total level milestones fire only for exactly 1750/2000/2200, each with a ScreenshotCapture screenshot - all other totals, including the previous max-cape (2277) special case, no longer alert. Gated on accomplishmentSharingEnabled.

No EventBus @Subscribe - there is no QuestCompleted event in this RuneLite version (confirmed by extracting the pinned client/runelite-api jars). Exposes checkQuests(), called from CatastrophicEventsPlugin.pollEvents()'s 45s loop, which reads Quest.getState(Client) for a fixed allowlist of 7 GM/special quests and tracks previous state per quest the same veteran-safe way as SkillMilestoneListener. Gated on accomplishmentSharingEnabled.

@Subscribe on ChatMessage, filtered to ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE (closes a chat-spoofing gap - previously unfiltered, confirmed exploitable via a real Discord incident); regex matches the three known pet-obtained message variants (first-time boss/minigame pet, duplicate pet roll, skilling pet). Captures a screenshot via ScreenshotCapture and attaches it to the alert. Gated on petDropSharingEnabled.

@Subscribe on ChatMessage, filtered to ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE (same chat-spoofing fix as PetDropListener); keyword-pair regex per reward (fire cape, infernal cape, Dizana's quiver) plus a completion-verb stem. Each reward gated by its own one-time ConfigManager flag (same pattern as CatastrophicEventsPlugin's DEATH_MESSAGE_NAME_TOKEN_MIGRATED_KEY) so it can never re-fire. Named to avoid ambiguity with the real Achievement Diary cape, which this feature excludes. Exact wording still unverified against a live client, see WRN-007. Gated on accomplishmentSharingEnabled.

modules.name: API DTOs
modules.responsibility: Gson-deserialized request/response shapes mirroring the catabot backend's JSON contract exactly, including snake_case-to-camelCase field mapping via @SerializedName.

key_files.purpose: Core event model - id, title, start_at, status, discord_channel_id, nested Attendance; owns isSignedUp() and minutesUntilStart() (throws on unparsable start_at).
Wraps the events list returned by GET /events.
POST /signup request body (event_id).
POST /signup response body (event_id, status).

modules.name: UI / Panel
modules.responsibility: Swing presentation layer: the top-level state-routed side panel (not-linked / connection-error / events, All Events vs. My Events tabs), presentational event cards, the inline settings form, and a small custom-painted widget kit backing the gold-on-black theme.

key_files.purpose: Top-level PluginPanel: state machine (NOT_LINKED/CONNECTION_ERROR/EVENTS), tab routing, 30s local re-render ticker, settings toggle.
Expanded 'featured' card for the soonest joined event on the My Events tab (countdown, attendance, join/view-event buttons, disabled 'coming soon' feature rows).
Compact list row used on All Events and for secondary joined events on My Events.
Inline 'Event Setup' form (gear icon) - reads/writes token, apiBase, websiteBase, guildId straight to ConfigManager.
Centralized color/spacing/font constants for the custom-painted theme (no default Swing L&F).
Custom-painted pill/outlined button variants used throughout the panel.
Round icon button used for the footer's Discord and settings-gear actions.
Rounded-rect card container used as the base of EventHeroCard and EventCompactRow.
Small rounded badge, used for the 'STARTING SOON' indicator.
Multi-line wrapping JLabel replacement, used for event titles.
Generated avatar/initial icon shown next to event titles.
